source_scope.paper: CaSKG: Counterfactual-Causal Skill Graphs for Scalable Agent Skill Retrieval, arXiv:2608.25500

findings.claim: CaSKG is a fresh ScienceWorld retrieval result built around a fixed reusable skill library and a state-filtered calibrated graph: across six backbones its macro-average ScienceWorld score rises from 72.62 for Graph-of-Skills to 80.50, with the downstream policy/task interface held unchanged by design.
findings.scope_guard: This manipulates retrieval structure, not receiver-side acceptance of an already fixed retrieved candidate.

findings.claim: The paper states that code is available at the advertised GitHub repository, but the exact public main revision inspected contains only README.md, whose content says that code will be released within a few days. As of this run, the advertised public repository therefore cannot replay the ScienceWorld graph construction/evaluation or bind the evaluated implementation bytes.
findings.scope_guard: Absence claim is restricted to the exact advertised GitHub public main surface at revision 39430e...; it does not claim no private or alternate artifact exists.

primary_public_evidence: arXiv abstract reports ScienceWorld macro 72.62 -> 80.50 relative to GoS across six LLM backbones and states code is available at github.com/ZhiyuanLi218/Caskg.
GitHub exact tree at 39430e... contains only README.md; README says code will be released within a few days.
causal_boundary: Useful fresh evidence that state-filtered skill retrieval improves ScienceWorld, but not the target fixed-selected-identity acceptance-only intervention; current advertised code surface is also not replay-ready.
